name: How should I maintain and clean my natural stone floors?

mainEntity.name: How should I maintain and clean my natural stone floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone floors require specific care to maintain their beauty and longevity. Regular cleaning involves sweeping or vacuuming to remove loose dirt and mopping with a pH-neutral, stone-specific cleaner. Avoid harsh, acidic, or abrasive cleaners, as these can etch or dull the stone's surface. Most natural stones also require periodic sealing, typically every 1-3 years, to protect against stains and moisture penetration. Promptly clean up spills to prevent staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain stone floors by sweeping, using pH-neutral cleaners, avoiding harsh chemicals, and sealing periodically to prevent stains.
